summary: Apply Codex hygiene principles, build practical controls, and prepare HACCP records across food value chains. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Food safety controls help food businesses prevent hazards through hygiene practices, process checks, and records. This course is for food safety and quality managers, SME operators, HACCP coordinators, and inspectors who need to assess hazards and prepare practical controls across food processing steps. Learners practise hazard registers, GHP and GMP checklists, monitoring and corrective-action records, digital traceability checks, and preliminary HACCP worksheets using meat, dairy, and other value-chain examples.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who establish, check, or support Codex-aligned food hygiene controls across processing and value chains.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with food handling, food production, quality assurance, inspection, or agricultural value-chain operations is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a product or process example from your workplace if available; no specific software installation is assumed beyond the optional Excel exercise.
